title: 길을 모르는 구름
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Indie Rock. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, arpeggiated riff in E major at 115 BPM. A male tenor vocal delivers rhythmic, melodic lines with light compression and subtle plate reverb. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a bright, round tone. Drums feature a tight snare and a steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern. During the chorus, a second overdriven electric guitar enters with sustained power chords and melodic lead fills. A subtle synthesizer pad provides harmonic density in the background. The arrangement uses a 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean arpeggiated electric guitar, syncopated bass, tight drums]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals]
기차를 타서 창가자리야
역을 벗어나서 논이 나왔어
초록이 널버 하늘과 논 사이에
아무것도 없어
바람이 별을 쓸어가잖아
레일이 일정하게 울려
이 리듬이 좋아서 창에 기대어
논 사이에 건물이 하나 보였어
작은 공장 같았어 또 하나 편의점
